message.skyabyss.titan_end.silence: The heartbeat has stopped. The whole back falls still.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.tremble.stone: The stone whale's back trembles faintly. The great chest draws a slow breath.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.tremble.tide_: The shell creaks, and a tide pulls away somewhere far off. It breathes out, slowly.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.tremble.thund: The wing-bones creak. The wind stills, and one last thunder drifts away.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.tremble.ember: The heat in the deep of the body ebbs away. The floor begins to cool.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.again.stone_w: The stone whale falls silent and sinks into the sea of clouds.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.again.tide_sh: The tide shell sinks into the sea. Only its coral terraces remain above the waves.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.again.thunder: The thunder wing folds its wings and sleeps on the peak like a crag.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.again.ember: The ember titan buries itself and becomes a cooled hill.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.wake.stone_wh: Far off in the sky, the song begins again.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.wake.tide_she: Far out at sea, something enormous stirs again.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.wake.thunder_: Beyond the peaks, thunder begins to rumble again.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.wake.ember: The ground beneath you grows faintly warm.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.sleeping: %s has left the world below and sleeps deeply. No one can board until it wakes.
message.skyabyss.titan_end.sleeping_call: %s sleeps deeply and does not answer the call.
